mark.alt: Two equal circles, and where they overlap a leaf grows
mark.caption: Two circles of the same size. Neither contains the other. What grows is what they share.

vision.title: Seven things this is built on

symmetry.title: Whatever one party gets, the other gets.
symmetry.body: When two people bring a problem here, the platform gives them the same instrument. Not similar — the same. These are the terms, and they are written once and applied to both.

rights.words: The same limit on what you may write
rights.statements: One statement each, at every stage
rights.visibility: Neither sees how long the other took
rights.withdraw: Either may stop, at any point, with no penalty
rights.facilitator: Either may change facilitator once, no reason asked

symmetry.caption: Both panels are generated from one list by one component, so they cannot drift apart: the terms are written once and applied to both. Neither is "the first party" — in a real case the platform gives each side a throwaway label chosen at random, so no fixed order exists anywhere, not even in the database.

join.title: The whole requirement is that you introduce yourself.
join.body: Not your religion, not your nationality, not which side you are from. We do not ask, and there is nowhere in this platform to put the answer.
